name: My Show

colors._comment: accent does double duty: card highlights AND the caption highlight word. Pick something readable over your footage, not just over the card.

typography._comment: serif for titles, sans for tags and captions

logos._comment: paths relative to this file. Leave empty to omit the logo entirely.

_caption_fixes_comment: [regex, replacement] pairs for words whisper reliably mangles: your field's jargon, proper nouns, product names. Add one each time you catch one in a render. After a dozen pieces the list stops growing.
